units.source_text: 当时迷信：庚申日之夜如果睡了，便有一种虫，叫作三尸虫，

en.t: According to the superstition of the time, if a person slept on the night of a koshin day, there was a kind of insect called the Three Corpses worm,

units.source_text: 上天去把这人的恶事告诉天帝，对这人不利。

en.t: which would go up to heaven and report that person's misdeeds to the Heavenly Emperor, bringing harm to that person.

units.source_text: 因此大家不睡，通宵做游戏。

en.t: For that reason, everyone stayed awake and played games all night.
